title: Research help from the library’s guides
description: Ask a research desk that answers from the library’s own guides and says which guide each answer comes from.
guide: For a librarian, in a workshop or on the library’s website. The research desk searches a knowledge base of four research guides, answers only from them with numbered citations, asks a question back before doing a learner’s work, and is tied to the durable skill of evaluating evidence (Carnegie Skills Progressions). Add your own guides or your website to the knowledge base, and turn on its chat page (Connect → Chat page) to put it on your site.
